props.gloss_en: the mishna: and one whose eyelashes fell out -- disqualified on account of appearance
'sachei shemesh': Rav Yosef taught 'sanei shemesh' (haters of the sun)
'zagdan': Rav Huna demonstrated: one [eye] of ours and one of theirs
the baraita: 'zagdom' -- one [eyebrow] black and one white
the stam: the tanna -- any pair that are not equal to one another he calls 'zagdom'
'tzayran': his eyes are trutot, or tziraniyot, tearing, dripping, streaming
it was taught: the zidder [is among the blemishes]
and the lufyan [is among the blemishes]
and the timyan [is among the blemishes]
timyan -- whose lashes are used up
the stam: no difficulty -- this where stumps [of the lashes] remained, that where stumps did not remain

objections.gloss_en: מיתיבי: שכבנא -- שגביניו שוכבים, זגדום -- אחד שחור ואחד לבן: the baraita's zagdom is of the eyebrows, not Rav Huna's mismatched eyes

answered_by.gloss_en: תנא: כל זוגא דלא שוי להדדי ״זגדום״ קרי ליה (= p_kol_zuga_zagdom)

objections.gloss_en: והני גבי מומין תנו להו? והתנן: שנשרו ריסי עיניו פסול מפני מראית העין! -- the mishna treats lost lashes as appearance only, not a blemish

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא, הא דאשתייר גרדומי, הא דלא אישתייר גרדומי (= p_ha_gardumei; which text has the remaining stumps is not said, header)
